The '''Sullustan Cargo Freighter''',<ref name="Episode IX" /> also known as the '''Sullustan Cargo Barge''',<ref name="SWKids">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Ship in the Star Wars Sequel Trilogy|video=bb3vhWXClTY|nolive=1}}</ref> was a model of [[freighter]] with [[Sullustan]] influence that was active during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. Many of these [[starship]]s joined the [[Citizens' Fleet]] that was assembled by [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] to aid the Resistance against the [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the [[Sith Eternal]] during the [[Battle of Exegol]]. It could hold cargo, had three [[engine]]s, and was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sullustan Cargo Freighter was first seen in [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]<ref name="Episode IX" /> and identified as such in the clip "A Final Alliance" behind the scenes featurette that comes with the [[Wikipedia:Target|Target]] exclusive of the home video.<ref name="io9">{{WebCite|url=https://io9.gizmodo.com/see-how-star-wars-most-impressive-fleet-was-created-in-1842223160|text=See How Star Wars' Most Impressive Fleet Was Created in This Exclusive Rise of Skywalker Clip|work=[https://io9.gizmodo.com Gizmodo]|date=2020-03-10|archivedate=20200311135740}}</ref>
